definitions: A small, typically medicated candy, often diamond-shaped, designed to be dissolved slowly in the mouth to soothe the throat or provide medication.
A bearing in heraldry, typically a diamond shape, often used to display the arms of a woman.
examples: She sucked on a lozenge to ease her cough.
The pattern featured a series of interconnected lozenges.
The shield displayed a lozenge with her family crest.
